verdict.rationale: Jumping to items by typing a short name or identifier is a fair navigation capability for a feedback-management product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents short IDs, a quick-jump command, or a search-by-key feature for feedback items, tasks, or initiatives. MCP querying and the issue-linking integrations are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump directly to any feedback item, task, or initiative by typing its short name
